[[File:Massassi_battle_staff.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Canderous Ordo]] wielding a Massassi battle staff.]]
The '''Massassi battle staff''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] once used by the ancient [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior race. The [[Staff/Legends|staff]] was the symbol of a proven warrior. It could be shortened with the press of a button, making it more convenient to carry.

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi battle staff was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
